meta.name: epic-hypothesis
meta.description: Frame an epic as a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. Use when defining a major initiative before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning.

copy.tagline: 将史诗级需求转化为可验证的假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将大型需求拆解为可验证的假设来指导产品方向。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn large initiatives into testable hypotheses to guide product direction.

howto.what: 将你的创意或功能想法转化为一个可验证的假设，包含目标用户、预期结果和验证方法。它会引导你填写“如果……那么……”结构，并设计轻量实验来测试假设。
howto.when: 当你需要定义一项重大举措（如新功能或项目），但在制定路线图、发现或交付计划之前，想先验证其可行性时触发。

say.text: 把“添加用量警报”做成一个史诗假设。
say.note: 技能会引导你填写假设结构。

say.text: 帮我为“批量删除功能”创建一个可测试的假设。
say.note: 技能会询问目标用户和预期结果。

howto.what_en: Transforms your initiative or feature idea into a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. It guides you through an if/then structure and designs lightweight experiments to test assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to define a major initiative (e.g., new feature or project) before committing to roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning, to validate its feasibility first.

say_en.text: Frame 'adding usage alerts' as an epic hypothesis.
say_en.note: The skill will guide you through the hypothesis structure.

say_en.text: Create a testable hypothesis for a bulk delete feature.
say_en.note: The skill will ask for target user and expected outcome.
